start: Menu: Workout plans (address /workouts), gym online, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Workout plans
user_sees: Title "Workout plans", under it "Send members their routines"; a line on when members see a plan; the card "Workout of the day"; the card "Plans", or "No workout plans yet" with "Make a plan once (for example “Beginner 3 days”) and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan."
must_not: "Only an owner can see this" for a owner; plans of another gym

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan"
user_sees: Sheet "New workout plan": ready plans to start from, or "Start empty" ("Pick every exercise yourself")
must_not: A ready plan saved before it was looked at

steps.action: Type a "Plan name", set the "Days of the plan", give a "Day name", add exercises with sets, reps and "Rest (seconds)"
user_sees: The exercise list to pick from, each with its "Main muscle"; "+ kg added (optional)" says "Empty: body weight only"
must_not: An exercise saved with no sets or with reps "NaN"

steps.action: Under "Send to" pick members, or everyone on a membership plan
user_sees: How many members will get it
must_not: Archived members, or members of another gym, in the choice

steps.action: Tap "Save plan"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the sheet closes; the plan is under "Plans" with who made it; the picked members get it in their app
must_not: Two plans from one tap; the plan saved but sent to nobody without a word

start: A member's page: "Send a plan" (one member at a time)

steps.action: Open a member and choose to send a plan
user_sees: A chooser: "Your gym’s plans" (one tap sends one), then "Or make one for them" with "Start from a ready plan" ("Beginner to advanced, filled in for you") and "Make a new plan" ("Pick every exercise yourself")
must_not: The chooser shown when workout plans are not part of the gym's plan (then one Pro note instead)

steps.action: Tap one of the gym's plans
user_sees: It is sent to this member; a bar offers Undo
must_not: The plan sent to every member; the member taken off other plans

steps.action: Tap Undo
user_sees: The member is off that plan again
must_not: The whole plan withdrawn for everyone

start: Workout plans: the card "Workout of the day" (one workout for everyone today)

steps.action: Tap "Set today’s workout"
user_sees: Sheet "Workout of the day"
must_not: Yesterday's workout offered as today's

steps.action: Pick or build the workout, tap "Save workout"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the card shows today's workout with "Change" and "Take it off"; the button now reads "+ Plan another day"
must_not: Two workouts for the same day

steps.action: Tap "Take it off"
user_sees: Sheet "Take this workout off?" with "Keep it" and "Take it off"; after yes, members no longer see it
must_not: It stays in the member app after being taken off

start: The plan builder: the trainer's own video on an exercise (another kind of content)

steps.action: On an exercise, fill "Your video of it (YouTube link, optional)" and a "Note (optional)"
user_sees: The link kept on that exercise
must_not: A link to a page that is not a video accepted with no word

steps.action: Save, then open the plan in the member app
user_sees: The member sees the trainer's video on that exercise
must_not: The video on the wrong exercise; a broken player

start: Wrong or missing values, no internet, and the Pro switch

steps.action: Tap "Save plan" with no plan name, or a day with no exercise
user_sees: A plain reason on top of the sheet; nothing saved; everything typed still there
must_not: An empty plan sent to members

steps.action: Type letters in "Reps from"
user_sees: Refused, or the box takes only numbers
must_not: "NaN" reps saved

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open Workout plans
user_sees: "Workout plans needs the internet" with "This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now."
must_not: A plan "saved" that never reaches the server

steps.action: A gym on the Starter plan, once the plan switch is on (it is off today)
user_sees: A page that says what Workout plans is and that it is part of Pro
must_not: The page working for free with the switch on; a blank page

start: A saved plan: edit, copy, withdraw

steps.action: Tap "Edit" on a plan, change a day, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Sheet "Edit workout plan"; after saving, members on the plan get the new version
must_not: The change saved over a newer change made on another device with no warning

steps.action: Tap "Make a copy"
user_sees: The builder with the same days as a new plan; the first plan unchanged
must_not: The copy sent to the same members by itself

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: Sheet "Withdraw this plan?" with "Keep it" and "Withdraw"; after yes the plan leaves "Plans" and members no longer get it
must_not: Members' own logged workouts deleted with the plan; "Could not withdraw it. Try again." with the plan half gone

steps.action: Show the withdrawn plans
user_sees: The withdrawn plan is listed there
must_not: A withdrawn plan still shown as running in the member app

start: Who gets a plan and who can see it

steps.action: Send a plan to three members
user_sees: Only those three see it in their app; the plan shows who made it
must_not: A member seeing a plan sent to someone else; a member seeing other members' names on the plan

steps.action: Look at what the desk and trainers can do here
user_sees: They can make, change, send and withdraw plans too
must_not: A Staff login blocked on this page while the menu shows it

steps.action: Read the member app's words on trainer plans
user_sees: The trainer's plans appear on the member's Workout tab by themselves
must_not: A plan that only appears after the member signs out and in
